name: Kibookal Madhubani Mithila Folk
composition: A dense Mithila folk composition on warm handmade-paper cream; the subject built from bold double-outline forms filled with fine hatching, cross-hatch and dot patterns; every empty space packed with flowers, fish, birds, suns and geometric fill; strong double-line border.
visual_traits: vibrant flat folk colour (vermilion, indigo, ochre, green, pink)
sun, fish, lotus, peacock, birds motifs
prompt_core: Create a Kibookal Madhubani (Mithila) folk illustration of [SUBJECT] on warm handmade-paper cream: build [SUBJECT] from bold black double-outlines filled with dense hatching, cross-hatch and dot patterns, vibrant flat folk colours (vermilion, indigo, turmeric, leaf-green, rose-pink). Fill every surrounding space with Mithila motifs — sun faces, fish, lotuses, peacocks, birds, flowering vines and geometric fill — inside a strong double-line border. Festive, narrative, hand-painted village-art energy; no empty space.
negative: no phone UI, no status bar, no Instagram interface, no caption text, no screenshot border; no photoreal, no 3D, no smooth gradients, no Western cartoon, no exact reference copy
render_directive: Render the requested SUBJECT / CHARACTER fully in THIS exact style. Keep the subject identity, key features and intended action recognizable, but the medium, palette, linework, motifs, ornament and finish are 100% this style. ANY character, deity, creature, person, animal or object can be rendered in this style — adapt the subject INTO the style; never bend the style toward the subject.

style_lock.medium: natural pigment + ink on handmade paper
style_lock.linework: bold black double-outline with dense fill
style_lock.palette: cream ground, vermilion, indigo, turmeric, green, rose
style_lock.character_rule: Render the requested SUBJECT fully in THIS exact tradition; identity stays recognizable, medium/palette/motifs/finish are 100% this style.
consistency: Match the built-in reference images for palette, motifs, linework and density.
Hold the palette and finish identical across every render.
Authentic Indian folk-art tradition — never Western, never anime.
